integrity: The theorem contains a full self-contained argument, exact finite corroboration and candid limits; no authorship, provenance, priority or independent verification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Odd primes only for the general statement; for p=3 the two quotients tie, and unique extrema require p>=5. Quotients are defined only for pairs of trinomial coefficients individually nonzero modulo p. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Exact adjacent trinomial quotient spectra and a sharp extremal reversal
